sect1.title: IsUSDaylightSavingsInEffect

row.entry: The date in Date_t format (YYYYMMDD). Optional; defaults to the current UTC date.
IsUSDaylightSavingsInEffect returns TRUE when U.S. daylight saving time is in effect for the specified date, otherwise FALSE.

sect1.para: The IsUSDaylightSavingsInEffect function returns TRUE if daylight saving time is considered in effect for the specified date under U.S. Federal schedules (where those schedules existed), otherwise FALSE.

This function uses a date-only approximation. The start transition date is inclusive and the end transition date is exclusive. If hour-level precision is required around transition times, use timestamp and timezone rules instead.

listitem.para: 1967 and later follows Uniform Time Act schedules, including the 1974-1975 exceptions and the 1987 and 2007 rule changes.

1942-1945 models WWII "War Time" as DST in effect. The current implementation uses 1942-02-08 as the inclusive start date (one day before the historical start, 1942-02-09) and 1945-09-30 as the exclusive end date.
1920-1941 and 1946-1966 returns FALSE because DST was not federally standardized and varied by locality.
State and local exemptions are not modeled.
